description: This file contains implementation of Galois/Counter Mode (GCM) cryptographic functions, including initialization, encryption, decryption, and hardware acceleration support for different architectures, as well as GHASH and GCM multiplication routines.

methods.name: CRYPTO_ghash_init
methods.description: Initializes GHASH and Galois multiplication tables based on the provided GCM key.

methods.name: CRYPTO_gcm128_init_key
methods.description: Initializes GCM128_KEY structure with AES key and hardware acceleration options.

methods.name: CRYPTO_gcm128_setiv
methods.description: Sets the IV (initialization vector) for GCM context, handling different IV lengths.

methods.name: CRYPTO_gcm128_aad
methods.description: Processes Additional Authenticated Data (AAD) for GCM.

methods.name: CRYPTO_gcm128_encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts data using GCM mode, updating authentication tags.

methods.name: CRYPTO_gcm128_decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts data using GCM mode, verifying authentication tags.

methods.name: CRYPTO_gcm128_finish
methods.description: Finalizes GCM authentication and verifies the tag.

methods.name: CRYPTO_gcm128_tag
methods.description: Generates the authentication tag for GCM.

methods.name: crypto_gcm_clmul_enabled
methods.description: Checks if hardware acceleration for GCM using CLMUL is enabled.
